posts.title: How to remove unused codes from Google Authenticator
posts.description: On current (Android 14/15) versions (2025 as of writing this) of the app Google Authenticator , the actions for editing and removing individual TOTP codes are surprisingly well hidden. The solution: both actions can be reached through swiping the list items: Swiping to the left: delete Swiping to the right: rename That’s all. I haven’t found that in writing even when Googling. Closest came this 30s video , but I believe that such knowledge should also be preserved in writing.
